retry.title: The reader did not connect
retry.description: Select **Submit** to get a new code and try again.

progress.pair:
Open the reader's local admin panel: **Settings > Integrations > Home Assistant and other servers**. Enter:

- Server address: `{url}`
- Code: **{code}**

Letter case and the dashes do not matter. The code can be used once and is valid for {minutes} minutes. This page continues by itself when the reader has connected.

error.pairing_expired: The code expired before the reader connected.
error.pairing_failed: The reader sent a wrong code too many times. Check the code and try again.

abort.no_url: Home Assistant has no URL the reader can connect to. Set the local network URL in Settings > System > Network.

add_card.title: Name a card
add_card.description: Every card has an ID such as `card_3f9a2c71` in the `card` attribute of the Punch entity. It stays the same, also on other readers, and does not reveal the card's UID. Here you can give a card a name instead. Cards without a name that punched since Home Assistant started are listed with their ID; you can also type the UID shown in the reader's admin panel. Automations that use the card's previous name or ID must be updated.

data_description.uid: Hex, for example 04A1B2C3. Spaces and colons are ignored.
data_description.name: For example the name of the person. Several cards can have the same name.

remove_card.title: Remove card names
remove_card.description: The selected cards get back their ID (`card_` and 8 hex digits).

uid.title: Card UID in punches
uid.description: When on, the Punch entity also has the raw card UID in its `uid` attribute. Every Home Assistant user can read entity attributes, and many readers accept a card with a cloned UID, so anyone who sees the UID can copy the card. Off by default; card IDs and names are enough for automations. The UID is never written to the history.

error.invalid_uid: Enter the UID as 4 to 7 bytes of hex, for example 04A1B2C3.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name. Names in the form of a card ID (`card_` and 8 hex digits) are reserved.

not_connected.message: The reader is not connected to Home Assistant

relay_timeout.message: The reader did not answer the relay command in time

relay_not_allowed.message: Remote relay control is disabled on the reader. Enable it in the reader's local admin panel

relay_invalid.message: The reader rejected the relay command as invalid

relay_busy.message: The relay is busy. Try again in a moment
